headline: Washington Controlled $12 Billion in Venezuelan Oil Revenue. Where Did the Money Go?
facebook_description: Washington managed $12.26 billion in Venezuelan natural resource revenue through September. Nearly all was disbursed, but the United States retains significant authority over how the money is released. Venezuela owns the funds. Commodity traders, refiners and Venezuelan businesses could benefit from the arrangement, but the ultimate recipients and commercial margins remain incompletely disclosed. Who controls the money, and who benefits? #EPNews #Venezuela #Oil #Geopolitics
